correctness.rationale: Explicitly derive the exact NGM for equal populations; P preserves the hub-plus-uniform two-space and its orthogonal complement. On the complement all infection multipliers are at most r<1, while a Rayleigh quotient gives a larger eigenvalue in the two-space; the exact 2-by-2 trace and determinant yield the global spectral radius. Positive-definiteness of the rank-one update gives the full sharp stability and critical boundaries, including endpoints. The exact rational verification runs 192 finite comparisons and 17 neutral checks; it is not used to prove the general case.

value.rationale: The authors of a directly motivated 2023/2024 epidemic-network paper ask whether heterogeneous symmetric star-class networks inherit the fully connected epidemic threshold for arbitrary numbers of patches. This theorem answers their Conjectures 3–4, adds all even sizes and arbitrarily connected symmetric peripheral blocks, and computes an exact R0 independent of extensive peripheral topology. It supplies a network-design invariance principle rather than an arbitrary small-parameter computation.
